sloka: प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने ।पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्त्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे ।। ६.११९.३२ ।।
transliteration: pracukruśuḥ striyaḥ sarvāstāṁ dṛṣṭvā havyavāhane ।patantīṁ saṁskṛtāṁ mantrairvasordhārāmivādhvare ।। 6.119.32 ।।

translations.english: All created beings and forms witnessed large eyed Sita descending on the golden altar, into the fire like goddess of fortune descending on her vehicle.
